topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; POL-01 (approved 2026-09-04) makes CPNI misuse a serious violation
gap: Code of conduct has no security or CPNI content and vendor agents do not acknowledge it
remediation: Annual acknowledgment of POL-05 by staff and vendor agents

control_description: Privately held with no board; the Chief Executive Officer (majority owner) approves the security budget and High risk acceptance
gap: No recurring owner-level security review
remediation: Quarterly security and POA&M review by the COO with the Chief Executive Officer, starting 2026 Q4

control_description: Security and compliance lead, CPNI compliance officer, and CALEA senior officer designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks at hire; CPNI module for in-house agents at hire
gap: No annual CPNI or role-based security training; vendor agents untrained

control_description: Sanctions process in POL-01 covers CPNI misuse; risk owners named in P01
gap: Sanctions not yet applied through HR procedure; vendor contracts lack equivalent discipline terms
remediation: HR procedure update; vendor contract terms (POAM-015)

control_description: OSS inventory of network elements; device management for endpoints; BIA and SSP describe the system
gap: Inventory lacks firmware versions and vendor support status
remediation: Add version and support fields; monthly review

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Five policies approved 2026-09-04 and published on the intranet
gap: Staff do not know how to report incidents; acknowledgments not yet collected

control_description: Online privacy policy and CPNI notice; enterprise contracts set CPNI terms; FCC certification filed each year
gap: Biennial opt-out notice overdue; no account change notices except password; certification statement inaccurate

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in the BIA (MTD, RTO, RPO) and the SSP categorization
SP 800-30 risk assessment completed 2026-07-31 with 34 risks
Pretexting, account takeover, and insider misuse assessed (R-003, R-004, R-021)
gap: No review of fraud by staff with billing adjustment rights
remediation: Add billing fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: None: the chatbot pilot started in April 2026 without a security or CPNI review
gap: No process to assess significant changes (new vendors, new channels, rule changes)
remediation: Security and CPNI review gate for new systems and vendors

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-14 (20 controls)
POA&M with owners and dates; accepted by the COO

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the Moderate baseline
gap: 46 of 78 controls only partially implemented

control_description: Identity provider MFA, EDR, TLS, and backups in place
gap: General controls over network elements weak (credentials, patching, hardening)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-04
gap: Supporting procedures (network element accounts, customer authentication, access review) not yet written
remediation: Procedures due with the POA&M milestones

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider single sign-on with MFA for workforce applications; role-based access in the BSS
gap: Shared accounts without MFA on network elements; flat management plane; customer reset uses SSN4 and date of birth

control_description: Accounts created from HR tickets with manager approval
gap: Overflow vendor agent accounts not managed by the company

control_description: Role-based access in the BSS, OSS, and cloud; same-day termination
gap: No access reviews; transfers not processed; broad export rights; over-privileged mediation account

control_description: Badge access, cameras, alarms at CO-1 and CO-2; separate badge group for the lawful-intercept room
gap: One common key for 42 remote cabinets; keys not inventoried

control_description: Certified destruction of drives and retired network elements

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Edge firewall; web application firewall for the portal; two upstream providers
gap: Edge routers behind on critical advisories; unsupported SBC; SBC management was exposed

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for portal, BSS, and APIs; IPsec between central offices and the cloud

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all 285 laptops and desktops and on cloud VMs; tablets under MDM
gap: EDR alerts not watched after hours; tablets lack EDR

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly external scans; nightly configuration diff for network elements
gap: No internal or authenticated scanning; no hardened baselines; vendor advisories not tracked

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: NOC monitors availability 24x7
gap: No security monitoring or log review; 30-day syslog

control_description: None for security events; outage escalation only
gap: No triage or breach determination process at assessment time

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbook approved 2026-09-04
gap: Not yet tested; reporting facility account not set up

control_description: Network restoration runbooks practiced each storm season
gap: No tested recovery for cloud workloads

control_description: Network changes through NOC maintenance tickets and windows
gap: No security review of changes; no change control in the cloud tenant
remediation: Extend change tickets to the cloud tenant with a security checklist

control_description: Storm plan; BIA; generators; cyber insurance
gap: No OSS/BSS recovery plan

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Annual review of the BSS vendor's SOC 2 Type 2 report
gap: No review of the chatbot, CCaaS, overflow call center, TTP, or SS7 hub
